applicability.applicable-to-profile: Primary role/transaction or explicit cross-cutting research need in this profile. Application to a real entity still requires its facts.
applicability.conditional: Additional contract, entity, period or framework fact is unresolved; retained in the open denominator.
applicability.excluded-for-stated-role: Specialized issuer/provider/lender/rate-regulated role is absent from this operating profile. The recorded trigger reopens it; no descendant exclusion follows.

adequacy.partial: Selected named questions have bounded answers; broader family and industry-specific branches remain open.
adequacy.sufficient: Requires every declared in-scope research question to have a traceable answer, applicable edition, complete inputs/workflow/control evidence and usable worked material where needed. No family or industry currently receives this status.

broader_family_questions.question: Which reporting entity, accounting basis, policy elections and effective requirements govern the question?
How do journals, accruals, reversals, cutoff and reconciliations produce a complete period ledger?
Which assumptions, specialists, revisions, bias indicators and sensitivities support estimates?
How are ledger balances classified, consolidated into statements, disclosed and tied to filing concepts?
Which functional currencies, exchange rates, remeasurement and translation facts matter?
Which transition cohorts, comparative periods and correction requirements apply?
What subsequent evidence, funding uncertainty and reporting-date boundaries require consideration?
Which entities, interests, control relationships, eliminations and noncontrolling interests belong in the reporting perimeter?
What is promised, who is the customer, and how do performance, pricing, changes, returns and principal-agent roles affect the analysis?
How do contract terms, progress evidence, cost forecasts, changes, billing and losses reconcile for each project?
How are supplier obligations, receipts, expenses, credits and unrecorded liabilities identified and reconciled?
Which rights to payment, collection populations, concessions and expected losses are supported?
How do bank, processor, payment-network and ledger records reconcile across timing and ownership differences?
Which quantities, ownership, cost layers, overhead allocations, spoilage and obsolescence affect inventory and margin?
Which expenditures create owner assets, when are assets ready for use, and how are depreciation, retirements and disposals supported?
Which contracts convey asset-use rights, and how do options, modifications, embedded leases and party roles matter?
What is being developed or acquired, who owns it, and which project stages, rights and costs require separate analysis?
How do worker status, time, compensation, deductions, payroll taxes and work locations reconcile?
Which benefit promises, plan assets, funding duties and actuarial assumptions require accounting and reporting?
What borrowing terms, modifications, extinguishments, collateral and covenant definitions govern the financing?
What ownership, redemption, conversion and distribution rights are attached to each instrument?
Which awards, vesting conditions, modifications, settlement choices and valuation inputs affect compensation?
Which instruments, business purposes, measurement bases, impairment models and disposal events matter?
Which contracts, embedded terms, risk exposures and designation evidence require derivative or hedge analysis?
Which units of account, markets, cash flows, assumptions and impairment triggers support the valuation?
What rights does the instrument convey, who controls it, and which asset, liability, custody or payment model applies?
How do current taxes, temporary differences, recoverability and uncertain positions connect to the reporting entity?
Which transaction, customer, product, location, exemption and import facts establish the obligation?
Which taxpayer, income type, ownership, reporting threshold, return and filing period apply?
Which legal entities, related-party flows, treaties, withholding, permanent-establishment and transfer-pricing facts matter?
Which timing methods, elections, aggregation rules, method changes and transition cohorts govern book-tax differences?
What is acquired or formed, who controls it, and which consideration, opening-balance and measurement questions follow?
Which ownership, common-control, service, funding and transfer terms need separate identification and evidence?
What obligation or exposure exists, what triggers recognition or disclosure, and how are ranges and recoveries supported?
Which coverage, deductibles, claims, premiums, cancellations and recovery rights affect the policyholder?
Which sale, closure, restructuring, liquidation or reorganization events change the accounting basis or obligations?
Which remediation, retirement, conservation, emissions or credit arrangements create measurable rights or obligations?
Who provides resources, what conditions and restrictions attach, and how are spending, release and return duties evidenced?
Which fund, appropriation, budgetary basis, interfund flow and government-wide reconciliation applies?
Which federal or sovereign reporting entity, budget authority, credit activity and stewardship obligations are relevant?
Which underwriting, contract boundary, reserve, reinsurance, acquisition-cost and statutory-reporting questions apply?
How do loan origination, servicing, transfers, deposits, guarantees and supervisory reports relate to the accounts?
Whose assets are held, which fund or trust is the reporting unit, and how do fees, allocations and client-asset reconciliations work?
Which rate-setting regime, recovery rights, obligations and regulatory accounts apply?
Which growing, harvested, mineral, exploration, development or depletion stages require distinct analysis?
How do service delivery, payer rules, contractual adjustments, estimates, settlements and cost reports reconcile?
Which territories, usage rights, minimum guarantees, production costs, royalties and participations attach to the content?
Which products, services, jobs and responsibility centers consume the costs, and how are allocation bases reconciled?
Which volume, price, capacity, cost and cash assumptions explain the plan and its uncertainty?
How are margins, unit economics and non-GAAP measures defined and reconciled to financial records?
What supports existence, completeness, rights, valuation and presentation for each material population?
Which error or fraud can occur, which control addresses it, and what evidence demonstrates its operation?
Which engagement, regulated population, grant, contract or special-purpose criteria require separate assurance procedures?
Which competence, independence, confidentiality, documentation and quality-management duties apply to the role?
Can the complete source population, transformations, revisions and ledger ties be reproduced for the accounting question?
Which contracts, schemas, identifiers, units, versions, exports and interface limitations govern the data?
Which access, tenant, retention, deletion, prompt-injection and information-disclosure boundaries apply?
Which planning, tool-use, calculation and retrieval designs are supported for the accounting task and its failure conditions?
Which judgments, exceptions and consequential actions require assigned authority, and how is review evidenced?
What did the study measure, on which population and controls, and what cannot be inferred about other accounting work?
Which observed outcomes, costs, failures and independent replications establish real-world performance?
Which source-level permissions, consent, provenance and restrictions govern retrieval, redistribution and training reuse?

dimensions.title: Supported treatment or research finding, with uncertainty
Documents, populations, assumptions and data lineage
Error modes, counterevidence, access and human review
Usable examples or data with explicit provenance and rights
Observed performance and transfer limits when a performance claim is made

method: All 96 authored activity profiles and all 1012 individual exception reviews were inspected. The 62 reusable family tests are composed with each profile; specific role exclusions are explicit. The 5952 cells are reproducible screening decisions, not 5952 literature reviews. Selected named answers and industry packages supply evidence leads, with shared-only evidence retained as an open industry question.

sufficiency.reason: Partial evidence and conditional applicability are retained; complete assessment does not mean complete evidence.
